fitReason: Visitor-first robotics-AI backup: substantive learned uncertainty representations and planning for autonomous UAVs, with an explicit visitor route and no verified learned physical execution.

physicalEvidence.summary: The complete 2026 obstacle-space paper trains a transformer on expert-generated convex uncertainty regions for UAV/robot path planning, testing numerical obstacle distributions. It is an uncertainty representation for downstream planning, not a verified flown policy; outputs have no formal instance-wise coverage guarantee. The separate 2026 neural bilinear Koopman study uses trained lifting networks and certified finite-time prediction bounds on simulated cart-pole and 2D quadrotor systems. A 2025 official summer-project description names real-world drone obstacle avoidance, but no complete execution/results evidence was established. Physical0; do not infer a deployed learned system from field-test claims or equipment.
